name: Telkaralura
sum: Telkaralura is the largest known gracilisuchid, a crocodile-line archosaur from the Carnian Chañares Formation of Argentina.
wsnote: Skull length 19.2-20.8 cm and femur about 19 cm, estimated (English Wikipedia); no body length.
biology: The sources consulted give no direct evidence of diet or habits.
author: von Baczko et al. 2025

sources.text: von Baczko, M. B., Ezcurra, M. D., Lecuona, A., Vega, N. and Desojo, J. B. 2025. A new large gracilisuchid from the Upper Triassic levels of the Chañares Formation, northwestern Argentina. Ameghiniana 62(5).

dates_note: No PBDB occurrences. Carnian per English Wikipedia (early Late Triassic); whole ICS stage used.
